title: Migrating from Service Mesh 2 to Service Mesh 3
subtitle: Migrating from Service Mesh 2 to Service Mesh 3 Hub

abstract.para: If you are planning a migration from OpenShift Service Mesh 2, move to version 3.1 rather than 3.0. Refer to the OpenShift Service Mesh 3.1 documentation, which includes a migration guide. Red Hat no longer supports OpenShift Service Mesh 3.0.
